queue.title: Powered width-1 vs width-2 proposal replication
queue.hypothesis: The n=24 width-2 recovery advantage reflects a real benefit of moderate proposal breadth rather than sampling noise.
queue.design: Continue the identical RNG-isolated width-1 vs width-2 implementation on 24 new unseen worlds, aggregate to total n=48, and bootstrap paired edge-error difference with compute accounting.
queue.primary_metric: paired width-2 minus width-1 edge error
queue.stopping_rule: complete at total n=48 or earlier if CI excludes zero

queue.title: Adaptive proposal-allocation swarm
queue.hypothesis: If moderate breadth survives replication, allocating the second proposal set selectively across epistemically distinct designers will outperform uniform width-2 at equal proposal-generation compute.

dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
